about: Curated human review decisions on extracted citation edges. Applied by scripts/build_graph.py after extraction, through the same review write the UI and MCP use (reviewer='curated'). Rejected edges stop counting in every lineage query. Each decision quotes the evidence; only unambiguous cases are listed, and edges that are merely suspicious are flagged in the UI (name_check='mismatch') instead.
